title: Five Simple Rules to Learn English – level 2
paragraphs: Many people study English for years, but they still can’t speak it well.
It is no surprise that students are looking for a better way to learn. Studies show that five simple rules can help.
First, learn new words in stories. Don’t learn only long word lists. Stories help you remember new words.
Second, practice the same words many times until you know them well.
Third, speak as much as you can. Reading and listening are important, but speaking helps you use English in real life.
The fourth rule is to use learning materials for your level. If they are too easy or too difficult, learning becomes harder.
Finally, have a clear plan and follow it every day.
LangoPlay is an English learning game that was created based on these rules. You can try it for free at www.langoplay.com.
